SEARCH
Package domain

Class PhysicsEngine

java.lang.Object
domain.PhysicsEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PhysicsEngine extends Object implements Serializable
Adapter of the physics library dyn4j (Adapter pattern). It is the only class that imports it: the rest of the domain works in pixels with Entity, and this class copies the entities to bodies of the library, advances the world and copies the result back. Each entity asks for its own kind of body (Entity.addTo(domain.PhysicsEngine)), so no type checks are needed. The ground, the walls, the ceiling and the crossbars are static bodies. The library is not serializable, so its world is rebuilt after opening a saved game.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda

    • onContact

      private void onContact(org.dyn4j.dynamics.Body a, org.dyn4j.dynamics.Body b, Match match)
      Reports a touch found by the library: when the real ball touches a player, the match decides whether a power shot comes out or hits; when it hits a wall, the ceiling or a crossbar, the shot is over. Other touches (players on the ground, fake balls) do not matter to the rules.
      Parameters:
      a - one body of the touch
      b - the other body
      match - the match being played
